Full e_i occurs with probability 1/4 independently across i. For nonall-one cyclic words, mark starts of t runs after a zero. Inclusion–exclusion over r cyclic starts separated by at least t+1 yields A(n,t)=4^n−1+Σ(-1)^r(n/r)C(n−rt−1,r−1)3^r4^(n−r(t+1)); all-ones is excluded explicitly. Independent disjoint components multiply extinction CDFs; infinite survival =1−Π(1−4^(−n_i)); a nonfull connected component dies by time n and the single-zero word attains n. Factorial moments for markers at t=floor(log_4n)+j converge to Poisson mean (3/4)4^(theta−j), giving lattice cutoff and phase-dependent limit; finite enumeration is not its proof.
